snippet.title: 2026 Total Solar Eclipse (Official NASA Trailer)
snippet.description:
The Sun and Moon are coming together to put on a show for Earth, and we'll be sharing it with you.

On Aug. 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will be visible in parts of Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and a small corner of Portugal.

Viewers in other places in the Northern Hemisphere will also have the chance to experience a partial solar eclipse, including parts of the U.S. (from Alaska to North Carolina), most of Canada, much of Europe, and northwestern Africa.

We'll be broadcasting the eclipse live, so you can experience totality from anywhere.

Learn how to watch totality live with us: https://go.nasa.gov/4ftKdXd
Learn more about this solar spectacle: https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/total-solar-eclipse-on-august-12-2026/

Credit: NASA

snippet.title: TOMBÉ DU CIEL Bande Annonce (2026) Jamel Debbouze, Ilyes Djadel
snippet.description:
Ilyes mène une vie joyeuse dans la banlieue de Roubaix. Seul problème : le bac. Après avoir échoué deux fois, c’est sa dernière chance de l’avoir et de rendre enfin fier ses parents. Mais un incendie survient pendant le bac blanc, et on l’accuse d’en être à l’origine… Exclu de son lycée, il doit quitter son quartier et aller dans le seul établissement qui l’accepte : le pensionnat catholique de Saint-Albert-le-Grand, en Bourgogne. Entre choc des cultures et quête de rédemption, Ilyes va devoir surmonter ses préjugés… Et ceux des autres.

Ce n'est pas qu'une autobiographie. C'est une confession.

Verity, avec Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson et Josh Hartnett, exclusivement au cinéma le 30 septembre.

Adapté du best-seller de Colleen Hoover, ce thriller psychologique suit Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway), autrice à succès, et Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), romancière en difficulté qui s’installe dans la propriété isolée des Crawford pour devenir la prête-plume de Verity. Lorsque Lowen met la main sur ce qui semble être les notes autobiographiques glaçantes de Verity, elle se retrouve confrontée à des confessions aussi dérangeantes que perverses sur Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), le mari de Verity, et peine dès lors à démêler la fiction de la réalité, la vérité du mensonge, la curiosité de l’obsession.

snippet.title: Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition Controllers | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Emergence Day is coming. Starting today, fans can pre-order the Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition XBOX Wireless Controller, and beginning September 30, customize their own Gears of War: E-Day controller with XBOX Design Lab. 

Inspired by the horror and brutality unleashed on Emergence Day, the Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition XBOX Wireless Controller captures the raw power of the Locust invasion with a battle-worn design built for fans. Drawing from the E-holes that scar the world of Gears of War: E-Day, the controller features 3D molded, laser-etched details of cracked asphalt with red, glowing cracks created by the power of an erupting E-hole, exposing the iconic Crimson Omen beneath the surface. Blacked-out ABXY buttons are punctuated by a transparent red X button, while matching red triggers and a transparent D-pad reflect the destruction left in the wake of Emergence Day. A dark silver metallic COG tag on the battery door signifies Never Fight Alone. Squad up. Textured grips round out a design built for fans ready to carry a piece of Sera into every battle.

Beginning September 30, fans can create their own Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition XBOX Wireless Controller with XBOX Design Lab, featuring exclusive artwork from renowned heavy metal illustrator Luke Preece. The centerpiece of the design is a custom top case featuring a skull perched atop crossed Lancers, surrounded by more skulls and battle-worn details inspired by the brutal conflict between the COG and the Locust Horde. Fans can make it their own with upgrades such as metallic triggers and D-pads, rubberized side and back grips, and a personalized engraving, creating a controller that reflects their connection to the world, characters, and legacy of Gears of War.

However you choose to play, the Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition controllers offer new ways to commemorate the grit, brutality, and devastation of Emergence Day. Claim yours and stand ready.

HA LEYLİM / _OH MY NOCTURNAL ONE_

Baş koydum senle aşkın yastığına / _I placed my head on the pillow of love with you_ 
Aşkolsun gelme görmezden / _I plead with you, don’t overlook me_
Yangın var bende söndürüver bari / _There’s a fire burning in me, won’t you put it out_
Bir rüzgar esti körfezden / _A wind just blew in from the bay_

Alsam versem de düşse bu süngü / _Let me take and let me give, so I can lower my guard_
O ağzında bir güneşlensem / _If only I could sunbathe in that mouth of yours_ 
Çektim çoktan kapılarına sürgüyü / _It’s been a long time since I have bolted your doors_
Ya teslim ol ya güreş benlen / _Either surrender or wrestle with me_

Kaptırdım seline, kandım meçhulüne / _I’m caught up in your flood, fooled by your unknown quality_
Sayende ağaç oldum burda / _Thanks to you I’m kicking my heels here_
Sokağında caddende / _On your side street, on your main street_
Sabrımın da sonu var biline / _May it be known there’s an end to my patience_
Kızgın demir hep avucumda / _The searing iron is always in my palm_
Darlandı müneccimler / _All the fortune-tellers are in distress_
Gel kurtar oku değdir kalbime / _Come rescue the arrow make it strike my heart_ 
Çabuk, haydi çabuk / _Rush, come on and rush_

Ha leylim bi’ ses ver be güzelim / _Oh my nocturnal one, call out to me, my beautiful one_ 
Bu gece bana gel şeker ezelim / _Come to me tonight, let’s crush our sweet crush_
Yaradan duysun da, muradımı versin de / _May God hear me, and grant me my wish_ 
Yaz maz gelsin gezinelim / _Let summer come so we can wander together_

Garibim, keşkem ve helalim / _My peculiar one, my wish, my rightful one_
Dola sen boynuma vebalin’ / _Embrace me, may its sin be on me_
Nişanımız olsun da, tüm kasaba bilsin de / _Let’s get engaged, and let the whole town know_
Sağ elinde dursun sol elim, sol elim / _Let me place my left hand, my left hand, in your right hand_
(Muhabbet bağında yüzelim) / _(Let’s wade in the orchard of affection)_
